psychological_meaning: Friar Gray evokes feelings of neutrality, contemplation, and subdued sophistication. It suggests a sense of calm reserve, practicality, and understated elegance. This color can promote a sense of stability and reliability, while also hinting at a quiet wisdom and introspection.
